   MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING
  CITY OF NORWALK PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION
  March 19, 2026

Commissioner Carbajal called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m.
Commission members present were Alejandra Hernandez, David King, Don Valenzuela,
Maria Carbajal, Antoinette Moreno, and Monique Yanez. Commissioners Anthony
Armendarez and Victor H. Juan were absent.

Staff Present included Director of Recreation and Park Services Allan Perdomo,
Recreation Superintendent Sonia Batres, Recreation Supervisor Maurisabel Camacho,
Recreation Coordinator Ivan Vargas, and Office Assistant II Vanessa Piceno.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Hernandez motioned to accept the February 12, 2026 meeting minutes.
Commissioner Yanez seconded the motion. All in favor.

REPORTS

2026 Egg-stravagant Egg Hunt

Recreation Supervisor Maurisabel Camacho presented details on the 2026 Egg-
stravagant Egg Hunt. The main event is scheduled for April 4, 2026, from 12:00 p.m. to
4:00 p.m. at Holifield Park, and will feature multiple egg hunt divisions, games, inflatables,
and a bunny photo opportunity. Attendance is expected to exceed 4,000 participants. She
also reported that local businesses have donated $50 gift cards, and that eggs will be
distributed throughout the city beginning the week of March 30 as part of the
Eggnourmous Egg Hunt. Commissioners were invited to volunteer at the event and were
asked to contact Recreation Coordinator Luis Valencia if interested. There were no further
questions following the presentation.

Park Project Monthly Update

Director Allan Perdomo provided a presentation on Park Project Updates. The
Commission was informed that multiple park improvement projects have been completed,
including field lighting renovations at several parks, HVAC upgrades, and solar panel
installations at key facilities. Updates were also provided on ongoing and upcoming
projects, including tentative improvements at Lakeside Park. Staff reported that the City
of Norwalk was awarded $4 million in grant funding for the Hermosillo Park Rehabilitation,
Stormwater Capture, and Infiltration Project. The Commission received updates on the
Holifield Park Master Plan, including community outreach efforts, survey participation,
and an upcoming timeline for review and presentations to the Commission and City
 Minutes of the Special Meeting

Council. Staff also shared that the Robert White Park Master Plan is in development.
Additional updates included the completion of camera and Wi-Fi installations at most
parks, with Robert White Park pending, and the installation of welded park signs at nearly
all locations, with a few remaining in progress. Commissioner’s questions were addressed
following the presentation.

STAFF COMMENTS

The Recreation Department team has welcomed a new member, Recreation Coordinator
Ivan Vargas. The team attended the California Park and Recreation Society Conference,
where the Teen Alliance Program was presented the 2025 Award of Excellence in the
Community Impact and Resilient Systems category. Director Allan Perdomo reminded
the commission that the Arastic event will take place tomorrow, March 20, 2026, and that
the next event will be the Egg-stravagant Egg Hunt on April 4, 2026.

COMMISISONER’S COMMENTS

Commissioner Moreno – Asks for staff and City to look into the possibility of adding
crosswalk to Bloomfield Blvd for persons to safely cross to and from Holifield Park.

Commissioner Yanez – No comment.

Commissioner Valenzuela – No comment.

Commissioner King – Shared that he had a great experience at the California Park
and Recreation Society (CPRS) Conference.

Commissioner Hernandez – She shared that she had a great time attending the
California Park and Recreation Society (CPRS) Conference. She also expressed that
she looks forward to reviewing the Holifield Park community engagement metrics and
seeing how the park concepts evolve based on community feedback.

Commissioner Carbajal – Thanked staff for everything that they do for the community.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
Patricia Delgadillo
